_doc: Claims the data is allowed to overturn. Edit freely. Each is evaluated live on the dashboard: share = |subset within of| / |of|, with a Wilson 95% interval. Verdict: supported if the whole interval is on the claimed side of the threshold, refuted if it is entirely on the other side, inconclusive otherwise, insufficient below min_n. Filter keys: is_need, area[], tier[], kind[], country[] (ISO numeric), keywords[] (any), min_cost, min_dissatisfaction, min_pay, min_severity.

hypotheses.statement: 护理/照护相关需求占全部真实需求信号的 5% 以上
健康医疗类需求中，超过 30% 有明确的支付证据（支付意愿 ≥ 2）
付出过真实代价（代价 ≥ 2）的需求里，超过一半对现有方案明确不满（不满 ≥ 2）
招聘/广告（有钱在动）的信号不到全部真实需求信号的 20%
